title: The algebra of linear transformations: sums, composition, invertibility, and isomorphism
objectives: Prove that linear maps form a vector space of dimension mn
Compose linear maps and use the algebra structure of operators
Characterize invertible and nonsingular linear maps
Identify finite-dimensional spaces up to isomorphism
prerequisites: Chapters 4 and 7: bases, dimension, linear maps and rank-nullity.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 13, 14 and 15 were read in full; the running matrices, the one-sided inverse examples and the exercises are original.
